extract.text: Boop A tiny, self-hosted notification inbox for developers. Something happened in one of your apps; Boop tells you on your phone. One Go binary, one SQLite file, one Docker container. Pushes go straight from your server to Apple's APNs. There is no hosted relay, account system, or telemetry. curl https://boop.example.com/api/v1/events \ -H " Authorization: Bearer $BOOP_API_KEY " \ -H " Content-Type: application/json " \ -d ' {"title": "Backup complete", "level": "success"} ' Architecture Your apps POST events with a project API key. The Go server redacts and stores them in SQLite, then pushes straight to Apple's APNs using your .p8 key. The push carries only the title, body and event id; the iOS app fetches the full event from your server with its own device credential. The embedded web UI manages projects and devices and shows the pairing QR the phone scans. An interactive version lives in docs/architecture/index.html (open it locally; the source is boop.architecture.json ). What is in the box Part Where Go server (API, SQLite, APNs, embedded web UI) server/ Web UI (Svelte, built into the binary) server/web/ iOS app (SwiftUI, iOS 26, you build and sign it) ios/ — see ios/README.md Client libraries separate repos — see Integrations Native desktop client planned Quick start (Docker) git clone https://github.com/chrisgreg/boop && cd boop cp .env.example .env # optional: BOOP_BASE_URL and APNS_* values mkdir -p data && chown 1000:1000 data # Linux hosts only; the container runs as uid 1000 docker compose up -d --build open http://localhost:8080 The first visit opens a setup wizard: server check, APNs, pairing, first project, test notification. APNs credentials are optional; without them events are stored and shown in the UI but pushes are skipped, and the settings page says so. Data lives in ./data/boop.db . Back up by copying that file (use sqlite3 data/boop.db ".backup backup.db" for a consistent copy while running). Back up your .p8 key separately. Send an event Create a project in the web UI and copy its API key (shown once). Then: # minimum curl http://localhost:8080/api/v1/events \ -H " Authorization: Bearer boop_proj_... " -H " Content-Type: application/json " \ -d ' {"title": "Deploy complete"} ' # rich curl http://localhost:8080/api/v1/events \ -H " Authorization: Bearer boop_proj_... catches.title: Research Design Tracking and Assessment for the Social Sciences
catches.ctx: Reliable assessment of causal research designs in the social sciences is critical for evidence-based policy-making, yet has so far relied entirely on manual expert analysis.
